body:
Now: 10 a try; 12% of prizes are a level-up paid in coins; no daily limit.
New: the level-up prize gives the level but no coins (like the designer room level-up). Coin prizes stay 20-50. Max 10 prizes a game day; after that Mr. Toby says the machine is empty until tomorrow.
Effect: about break-even for a good player; prizes are furniture and fun.

comments.text: Karolis said 'do the rebalance' in the Schedules and economy chat (30 Oct): approved. Built as a code patch (economy-rebalance.patch, build 2026103101) and checked with the quick kit; goes live through a pull request in the next repo chat.

short: Claw machine: 10 prizes a day, level prize no coins
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team
title: Balance 3: claw machine is fun, not a money printer
